topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: Oh no, I can't even imagine how you're feeling right now, stuck there with nothing but time and all this buzzing frustration around you. I know that event was huge for you, not just another thing on the calendar but something that mattered, something you were really counting on. And now this? It's like the universe is playing the cruelest game of hide and seek. But listen, I know you, and you've got this strength that doesn’t just fade away because of a derailed plan. There's got to be a way to still make a difference, to still show up, even if it's not how you envisioned it. Let’s figure it out together. I’m right here, ready to brainstorm, to call in favors, to do whatever it takes. You’re not alone in this, promise.
